title: The Vanished Jazz Vinyl
scene: At 6:30 PM, the jazz vinyl vanished from the study. The lounge phonograph plays a full 40-minute record before stopping automatically.

suspects.name: Leo Vance
suspects.testimony: I tuned the upright piano in the hall from 6:00 to 6:35 PM, right outside the study door.
suspects.alibiProof: The housekeeper heard Leo tuning the hall piano continuously from 6:00 to 6:35 PM.

suspects.name: Gideon Park
suspects.testimony: I mixed lemonade in the kitchen from 6:05 to 6:30 PM and never stepped into the study.
suspects.alibiProof: Two guests chatted with Gideon in the kitchen from 6:05 to 6:30 PM while he poured drinks.

suspects.name: June Mercer
suspects.testimony: I jotted notes on the porch from 6:00 to 6:30 PM, watching the sunset over the lawn.
suspects.alibiProof: A neighbor waved to June on the porch at 6:10 and 6:25 PM while walking his dog.

suspects.name: Mira Solis
suspects.testimony: I put a full record on the lounge phonograph at 6:00 PM and sat listening until it stopped at 6:25 PM.
suspects.contradiction: A 40-minute record started at 6:00 PM runs until 6:40 PM, and the jazz sleeve was in Mira's tote.
